resources.string: Supplies sunrise, sunset, twilight, moon, and tide times to the Nightwatch watch face.
Nightwatch uses your approximate location, even when the app is closed or not in use, so the face’s times follow you when you travel. It never leaves this watch.
Location: not allowed. Times are for your time zone’s main city until you allow it.
Location: allowed only while open. Choose “Allow all the time” so the times follow you when you travel.
Location: allowed all the time. Times follow you when you travel.
Then choose the Nightwatch watch face. Nothing else to set up.

Not for navigation. Everything shown (sun, moon, tides) is an approximate prediction made on the watch; tides come from the nearest tide gauge, which may be far away. Use official tables for anything that matters.
